[00:00-00:02.25] 镜头1：杠铃硬拉·由局部推进人物（Deadlift Reveal）
第一帧直接使用低机位特写：女主双手正握杠铃，双脚约与髋同宽，米白色运动鞋稳稳踩在黑色橡胶地面上，杠铃两侧安装相同尺寸的黑色重量片。

她通过腿部和髋部同时发力站直，杠铃沿小腿和大腿近距离上升；到达最高点时身体直立、肩膀自然下沉，不夸张后仰。

硬切至侧后方全身中景，女主与完整杠铃同时入画。

女主先向后推髋并弯曲膝盖，身体下降，双手稳定握住杠铃；随后双脚发力，杠铃离开地面，沿着小腿和大腿平稳上升。

完整表现：

向后推髋并降低身体；
双手握紧杠铃；
杠铃离开地面；
杠铃贴近双腿上升；
女主站直；
杠铃在大腿前方短暂停顿。

女主全程保持身体稳定，目光向前，头部不随杠铃上下晃动。

[00:03.33-00:04.08] 镜头3：硬拉力量特写（Power Close-up）
切换至低角度侧后方近景。

女主开始下一次硬拉。镜头重点表现杠铃贴近腿部向上移动、运动裤布料随着肌肉发力产生轻微拉伸，以及重量片受到惯性影响产生的短促震动。

女主站直的一刻精准踩中音乐重拍，随后立即硬切至下一项训练。

低机位侧拍：女主从髋部较低的位置开始，双脚向下发力，把髋部和杠铃稳定推高。

到达最高点时，肩膀、髋部与膝盖形成稳定斜线。髋部短暂停顿，随后控制杠铃缓慢下降。

在约1.2秒内完成一次清楚的臀推动作，不能快速弹跳，不能过度拱腰。双手始终自然扶住杠铃保护垫。

[00:05.29-00:06.70] 镜头5：倒蹬机第一角度（Leg Press）
女主坐进倾斜式倒蹬机，背部和头部贴住黑色靠垫，双手握住座椅两侧把手。

侧面中景：双脚约与肩同宽踩在踏板中央，米白色厚底运动鞋和白色中筒袜清晰可见。

女主先控制踏板下降，双膝向身体靠近；到达舒适深度后立即反向发力，把踏板平稳推远。

双腿接近伸直时保留轻微弯曲，不完全锁死膝盖。完成一次完整的“屈膝下降→双脚发力→踏板上升”，器械滑轨产生真实机械声。

[00:06.70-00:08.45] 镜头6：倒蹬机连续训练（Leg Press Rhythm）
切换到更低、更靠近脚部的侧面机位。

女主继续完成两次节奏清楚的倒蹬：

第一次以中等速度下降和推出；
第二次随着音乐加快，下降稍快、推出更加有力。

镜头重点表现膝盖屈伸、鞋底压住踏板和倾斜滑轨移动。女主的臀部、背部与头部始终贴住靠垫，不能离开座椅。

最后一次推出后，双腿在安全范围内保持约0.2秒，音乐短暂停顿，随即切换到跑步机。

[00:08.45-00:09.50] 镜头7：跑步机脚步卡点（Treadmill Footwork）
跑步机履带超近特写。

米白色厚底运动鞋交替落在快速向后移动的黑色履带上，白色罗纹中筒袜和灰色运动裤裤脚清晰可见。

左右脚按照音乐节拍连续落地，鞋底每次接触履带后迅速蹬离；其中一个瞬间双脚短暂同时离开履带，形成自然的跑步悬空状态。

镜头贴近履带低角度跟拍（Low-angle Tracking），表现真实脚步冲击、鞋底压缩和履带运动。

[00:09.50-00:10.67] 镜头8：跑步中的面部特写（Running Close-up）
镜头从跑步鞋快速向上摇至女主上半身与面部。

女主保持稳定跑步节奏，双臂在身体两侧自然前后摆动，肩膀放松；短款上衣和运动裤随着跑动产生细微自然褶皱。

切面部近景：几缕碎发随着跑动轻轻摆动，女主目光看向前方，嘴唇微张、呼吸稍快，脸颊带有少量真实汗水。

动作保持自然克制，不看镜头，不摆拍。

[00:10.67-00:12.00] 镜头9：训练结束·镜前自拍（Mirror Selfie）
快速硬切至健身房镜前自拍。

女主站在镜子正前方，身体略微侧向镜面，一只手在胸前举着手机拍摄；手机位置低于眼睛，不完全遮住脸。

另一只手向镜子举起大拇指。女主先轻轻抿嘴，随后露出克制满意的微笑，肩膀放松，胸口随着训练后的呼吸轻微起伏。

镜头由上半身缓慢拉远至大腿位置，展示深炭灰色长袖短款上衣、灰色高腰运动裤和自然低丸子头造型。

最后0.4秒保持竖起大拇指的姿势，女主通过镜面看向手机屏幕，定格结束。

【动作与连续性要求】
训练顺序固定：杠铃硬拉→杠铃臀推→倒蹬机→跑步机→镜前自拍。
杠铃硬拉必须让杠铃贴近小腿和大腿上升，不能变成深蹲、杠铃划船或挺举。
臀推必须由髋部带动杠铃上下移动，不能生成成卧推。
倒蹬必须让踏板沿倾斜滑轨运动，人物身体不能在器械上滑动。
跑步机履带持续向后运动，女主身体保持在跑步机中央。
每次切换器械使用音乐重拍硬切，不使用烟雾、粒子或身体变形转场。

【负面约束】
不要第二名主要角色，不要教练辅助，不要复制女主。
不要人物换脸、发型改变、服装变色或上下装漂移。
不要多余手臂、多余腿、多余手指、双脚粘连或关节反向弯曲。
不要杠铃穿过身体、重量片改变数量、器械变形或踏板漂浮。
不要严重弓背、膝盖内扣、臀推过度拱腰或倒蹬完全锁死膝盖。
不要让运动动作失去负重感，不要慢吞吞摆拍。
不要复杂镜面重复人物，不要镜中出现额外女主或错误动作。
不要对白、字幕、标题、健身数据贴纸、Logo、水印或乱码文字。
不要动漫、卡通、塑料CG皮肤、过度磨皮或夸张汗水特效。
extra-40286e579493.en:
Fitness girl vlog video📺

Seedance 2.5 prompt 👇

[Style] Photorealistic Fitness Video, beat-synced rapid cuts, sports commercial texture, real strength and equipment physical feedback, 4K HD, natural skin, sweat, and fabric texture
[Duration] 12 seconds
[Aspect ratio] 9:16 vertical
[Scene] Modern commercial gym, black-gray strength equipment, dark rubber floor, large wall mirrors, black ceiling with continuous white linear light strips; background has only a few blurred gym-goers, not stealing focus
[Character] Single female lead @图片1; face shape, facial features, and body proportions strictly reference the image. Dark long hair tied in a natural low bun, with a few loose strands on both sides; wearing a dark charcoal-gray long-sleeve fitted cropped henley sports top, gray high-waist fitted sports pants, white ribbed mid-calf socks, off-white thick-sole sneakers
[Sound] No dialogue, no subtitles; clear-rhythm workout electronic music, barbell plate clanking, machine rail sliding, breathing, and treadmill footstep sounds precisely on beat

[00:00-00:02.25] Shot 1: Barbell deadlift · reveal character from a detail (Deadlift Reveal)
First frame directly uses a low-angle close-up: the female lead grips the barbell with both hands overhand, feet about hip-width apart, off-white sneakers planted firmly on the black rubber floor, identical-size black weight plates loaded on both sides of the barbell.

The female lead keeps her back naturally flat, feet pressing the ground, the barbell moving upward close to her shins. The camera tracks vertically along the barbell from bottom to top (Vertical Tracking), passing in sequence over her hands, gray high-waist sports pants, dark charcoal-gray cropped top, and finally arriving at her face.

She stands straight by driving with legs and hips simultaneously, the barbell rising close along shins and thighs; at the top point her body is upright, shoulders naturally lowered, without exaggerated leaning back.

Cut to facial close-up: the female lead's gaze focused forward, lips slightly parted, a short exhale; a small amount of real workout sweat on forehead and cheeks.

The barbell briefly pauses at the top, the weight plates wobble slightly, matched with a low metallic clank.

[00:02.25-00:03.33] Shot 2: Second deadlift · full movement (Full Deadlift)
Hard cut to a rear-side full-body medium shot, the female lead and the complete barbell both in frame.

The female lead first pushes her hips back and bends her knees, body lowering, hands steadily gripping the barbell; then her feet drive, the barbell leaves the ground, rising smoothly along shins and thighs.

Fully show:

push hips back and lower body;
grip the barbell tightly with both hands;
barbell leaves the ground;
barbell rises close to both legs;
female lead stands straight;
barbell briefly pauses in front of thighs.

The female lead keeps her body stable throughout, gaze forward, head not bobbing up and down with the barbell.

[00:03.33-00:04.08] Shot 3: Deadlift power close-up (Power Close-up)
Cut to a low-angle rear-side close shot.

The female lead begins the next deadlift. The camera focuses on the barbell moving upward close to the legs, the sports pants fabric slightly stretching as muscles engage, and the short vibration of the weight plates affected by inertia.

The moment the female lead stands straight lands precisely on the music's heavy beat, then immediately hard cuts to the next exercise.

[00:04.08-00:05.29] Shot 4: Barbell hip thrust (Barbell Hip Thrust)
The female lead's upper back rests on the edge of a flat training bench, feet planted firmly on the ground, knees bent; a barbell with a protective pad lies across her hips.

Low-angle side shot: the female lead starts from a lower hip position, feet drive downward, pushing hips and barbell steadily upward.

At the top point, shoulders, hips, and knees form a stable diagonal line. The hips briefly pause, then control the barbell slowly lowering.

Complete one clear hip thrust within about 1.2 seconds, no fast bouncing, no excessive lower-back arching. Both hands always naturally hold the barbell pad.

[00:05.29-00:06.70] Shot 5: Leg press first angle (Leg Press)
The female lead sits in the inclined leg press machine, back and head against the black pad, both hands gripping the handles on both sides of the seat.

Side medium shot: feet about shoulder-width apart on the center of the platform, off-white thick-sole sneakers and white mid-calf socks clearly visible.

The female lead first controls the platform lowering, knees approaching her body; after reaching a comfortable depth, immediately drives in reverse, pushing the platform smoothly away.

When legs are nearly straight, keep a slight bend, without fully locking the knees. Complete one full "bend knees and lower → feet drive → platform rises," with the machine rail producing real mechanical sound.

[00:06.70-00:08.45] Shot 6: Leg press continuous training (Leg Press Rhythm)
Cut to a lower side camera position closer to the feet.

The female lead continues to complete two clearly rhythmic leg presses:

The first lowers and pushes out at medium speed;
the second speeds up with the music, lowering slightly faster and pushing out more powerfully.

The camera focuses on knee flexion and extension, shoe soles pressing the platform, and the inclined rail moving. The female lead's hips, back, and head always stay against the pad and must not leave the seat.

After the final push-out, the legs hold for about 0.2 seconds within a safe range, the music briefly pauses, then immediately cuts to the treadmill.

[00:08.45-00:09.50] Shot 7: Treadmill footwork on beat (Treadmill Footwork)
Extreme close-up of the treadmill belt.

Off-white thick-sole sneakers alternately land on the fast backward-moving black belt, white ribbed mid-calf socks and gray sports pants cuffs clearly visible.

Left and right feet land continuously according to the music beat, each sole quickly pushing off after contact with the belt; at one instant both feet briefly leave the belt simultaneously, forming a natural running airborne state.

The camera follows at a low angle close to the belt (Low-angle Tracking), showing real foot impact, sole compression, and belt movement.

[00:09.50-00:10.67] Shot 8: Facial close-up while running (Running Close-up)
The camera quickly tilts up from the running shoes to the female lead's upper body and face.

The female lead maintains a steady running rhythm, arms swinging naturally back and forth at her sides, shoulders relaxed; the cropped top and sports pants form subtle natural wrinkles with the running.

Cut to facial close-up: a few loose strands sway gently with the running, the female lead's gaze forward, lips slightly parted, breathing slightly fast, a small amount of real sweat on her cheeks.

Movement remains natural and restrained, not looking at the camera, not posing.

[00:10.67-00:12.00] Shot 9: Training finished · mirror selfie (Mirror Selfie)
Quick hard cut to a gym mirror selfie.

The female lead stands directly in front of the mirror, body slightly angled toward the mirror, one hand holding the phone in front of her chest to film; the phone position is lower than her eyes, not completely covering her face.

The other hand raises a thumbs-up toward the mirror. The female lead first lightly presses her lips together, then reveals a restrained satisfied smile, shoulders relaxed, chest rising and falling slightly with post-workout breathing.

The camera slowly pulls back from upper body to thigh position, showing the dark charcoal-gray long-sleeve cropped top, gray high-waist sports pants, and natural low bun look.

The final 0.4 seconds maintain the thumbs-up pose, the female lead looks at the phone screen through the mirror, freeze-frame ending.

[Action and Continuity Requirements]
Training order fixed: barbell deadlift → barbell hip thrust → leg press → treadmill → mirror selfie.
The barbell deadlift must have the barbell rising close to shins and thighs, and must not become a squat, barbell row, or clean and jerk.
The hip thrust must be driven by the hips moving the barbell up and down, and must not be generated as a bench press.
The leg press must have the platform moving along the inclined rail, and the character's body must not slide on the machine.
The treadmill belt continuously moves backward, and the female lead's body stays in the center of the treadmill.
Each equipment switch uses a music heavy-beat hard cut, without smoke, particles, or body-morphing transitions.

[Negative Constraints]
No second main character, no coach assistance, no duplicating the female lead.
No face swapping, hairstyle changes, clothing color changes, or top/bottom outfit drifting.
No extra arms, extra legs, extra fingers, fused feet, or reverse-bent joints.
No barbell passing through the body, weight plate count changes, equipment deformation, or floating platform.
No severe back rounding, knee valgus, excessive lower-back arching in hip thrust, or fully locked knees in leg press.
Do not let the exercise movements lose the sense of load, do not pose slowly.
No complex mirror duplicating the character, no extra female lead or wrong movements in the mirror.
No dialogue, subtitles, titles, fitness data stickers, logos, watermarks, or garbled text.
No anime, cartoon, plastic CG skin, excessive skin smoothing, or exaggerated sweat effects.

创作一段30秒、1080p的超写实个人家庭录像，展现一位年轻韩国男子平凡的一天。无参考图。

主要人物

二十出头的年轻韩国男子，自然帅气，真实皮肤质感，几乎不修饰，神情放松、略带睡意。

中等长度、自然凌乱的黑色头发，淡淡的胡茬，几缕碎发垂在额前。

穿着宽松的褪色炭灰色T恤、宽松橄榄色长裤、旧运动鞋，戴一块简约银色手表。

在整个视频中保持相同的脸、发型、服装、身体比例和外观。

场景

温暖夏日午后，一个安静的旧式住宅街区。

小型公寓楼、狭窄的混凝土小巷、屋顶露台、社区洗衣店、街角小店、停放的自行车、盆栽植物、电线、混凝土楼梯、投下斑驳树荫的树木，以及过着日常生活的普通人。

一切都应显得有人居住、真实自然。

摄影/视觉美学

由朋友随手拍摄的原始个人影像。

手持摄影机带有自然晃动、构图不完美、偶尔局部裁切、自动对焦拉风箱、阳光与阴影之间的曝光变化、轻微运动模糊、画面细节柔和、细微数字噪点、略微褪色的色彩，以及自然的摄影机瑕疵。

拍摄者与他同行，并自然反应。

无防抖、无电影式运镜、无戏剧化灯光、无慢动作、无精致商业外观。

影像应显得偶然地美，而非刻意电影化。

⸻

00:00–00:05 — 出门

他提着一个小号可重复使用购物袋走出公寓。

他锁上门，检查口袋里的钥匙和手机，然后开始下楼。

摄影机跟在他身后。

他短暂回头看向摄影机，露出一个睡眼惺忪的半个微笑。

⸻

00:05–00:10 — 上午跑腿

他穿过安静街区的小巷，走向一家本地小杂货店。

他经过停放的自行车和在家门外浇植物的人。

他在路边水果摊前停下，拿起几个橙子，随意查看后放进袋子里。

摄影机短暂对焦水果，然后回到他的脸上。

⸻

00:10–00:15 — 小憩

他坐在店外一堵低矮的混凝土墙上。

他打开一瓶冷饮，喝了几口。

一阵微风吹动他的头发。

他沉默地看着路人经过。

摄影机保持轻微晃动、构图不完美，就像他的朋友只是坐在旁边拍他。

⸻

00:15–00:20 — 走回家

他起身继续走。

一辆自行车从他身后经过。

他注意到一只流浪猫坐在墙边，蹲下轻轻抚摸它。

猫走开了。

他轻声笑了笑，重新站起来。

拍摄者靠近时不小心切掉了他的部分头部，随后迅速重新构图。

⸻

00:20–00:25 — 屋顶

他回到家，走上一个小屋顶。

他把购物袋放在一把旧椅子旁。

他靠在栏杆上，眺望整个街区。

午后阳光自然地落在他脸上。

他用手拨弄凌乱的头发，安静地望着远处的建筑。

⸻

00:25–00:30 — 最后时刻

他注意到摄影机还在录制。

他直视镜头，露出一个略带好笑的微小笑容。

他随口说道：

“You’re still recording?”（“你还在录？”）

他摇摇头，朝摄影机走来。

他靠近时，摄影机略微后退。

在他到达摄影机之前，录像突然切黑。

⸻

音频

仅使用自然环境声：

脚步声、远处交通声、自行车声、鸟鸣、风声、街区谈话声、店铺声音、开瓶声、布料摩擦声、关门声，以及细微的手持摄影机噪声。

无音乐。

无旁白。

无人工音效。

只有一句台词：“You’re still recording?”（“你还在录？”）

场景
京都一个安静的旧式住宅街区，温暖的夏日傍晚。狭窄的铺装街道、低矮的木屋、晾晒的衣物、自动售货机、电线杆、缠绕的架空电线、街角小便利店、远处可见的神社门、树上鸣叫的蝉，以及横跨道路的长长树影。

由朋友用2000年代早期消费级DV摄像机随手拍摄的原始个人影像。
强烈的手持晃动、不完美的构图、自动对焦拉风箱、曝光变化、偶尔的运动模糊、褪色的色彩、柔和的数字细节、轻微噪点、意外变焦和自然的摄影机瑕疵。

— 屋外
她拿着一把小纸扇走出门。她拉上门，瞥了一眼窗户里的倒影，然后看向摄影机，害羞地笑了。
温暖的晚风吹动附近的风铃，她开始沿街走去。
— 便利店停留
她走到街角小店，买了一根冰棍。
她走到外面，撕开包装，咬下第一口，因味道而开心地皱起脸。
她注意到朋友在拍摄，笑着朝摄影机挥了挥冰棍，然后又咬了一口。
— 走回家
她一边吃一边继续走在安静的街道上。
一只拴在店外的小狗轻声叫唤，摇着尾巴。她跪下，轻轻挠它的耳后。
狗的主人把它叫回去，她站起来，咯咯笑着继续走。
— 小意外
她走过一条低垂的晾衣绳时，一块掉落的床单擦过她的头。
她停下，吓了一跳，然后意识到发生了什么，大笑起来。
她拍了拍头发，而她的朋友笨拙地把镜头推近她的脸。
她直视镜头说道：
“Mou, yamete!”（“真是的，别闹了！”）
— 安静时刻
她走到神社门附近的一小段石阶旁，坐下片刻。
她吃完冰棍，看着灌木丛附近开始隐约闪烁的萤火虫。
一阵微风拂动她的头发。她把一缕碎发别到耳后，平静地环顾四周。
— 最后时刻
她站起来，继续走回家。
走了几步后，她回头看向摄影机，露出温柔俏皮的微笑，说道：
“Hayaku kite.”（“快点来。”）
她继续走在昏暗的小巷里，路灯闪烁亮起，摄影机跟在后面。
她消失在拐角处，录像突然切黑。

一位留着短波波头的年轻东亚女性坐在布鲁克林风格凌乱公寓卧室的宽大窗台上。她穿着黑色长袖上衣、带深色领带的红色衬衫、灰色工装裤（腰间系着一件浅蓝色毛衣）、粉红色与红色袖套、亮白色袜子和青绿色运动鞋。紫色头戴式耳机挂在她脖子上。房间里堆满动漫海报（包括《龙珠》）、漫画书、一罐Monster Energy、Funko Pop玩偶、散落在地板上的衣服，右侧有一张床。敞开的大窗外是多云的纽约市天际线，红砖建筑林立。
她看着镜头微微一笑，戴上耳机，向后靠，然后突然荡出窗外，抓着一根细细的白色蛛丝。动态跟拍镜头跟随她穿梭于纽约街头：她在带消防梯的砖砌公寓楼之间飞荡，越过挤满黄色出租车和行人的繁忙十字路口，掠过街角商店和红绿灯，在空中杂技般地俯冲、翻转。镜头随她移动——仰视低角度、俯视高角度，城市带有快速运动模糊。
她落在屋顶上，双臂张开得意地站立，头发飘扬，眺望黄金时刻的天际线。视野包括水塔、密集的屋顶、东河，以及远处在柔和夕阳中发光的世贸中心一号楼。电影感、写实真人风格，色彩鲜艳，动作充满活力，灵感来自超级英雄蛛丝飞荡场景。
